items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: I still see Joe once in a while, not too often... We always have a little chat every time I see him.

ctx.x: And one of the books says it has a banjo on it, but I never heard the banjo.
Well, on one of the recordings I made, I think Joe... Not Joe Valenti. Joe... Oh, what's this guy's name?
